title: College Football
description:
Ohio State at Nebraska
The No. 14 Buckeyes (7-3, 5-2 Big Ten) face the Cornhuskers (6-4, 3-4) at Memorial Stadium. Ohio State enters after a 28-19 victory against Northwestern behind Luke Fahey, while Nebraska snapped a skid and beat Rutgers for a shutout 31-0 win.

title: College Football
description:
Texas Tech at Baylor
The Baylor Bears host the No. 12 Texas Tech Red Raiders at McLane Stadium in a Big 12 matchup. Texas Tech aims for a four-game win streak after defeating Oklahoma State 52-27, while Baylor broke a two-game win streak with a 28-7 loss against BYU.

title: College Basketball
description:
Michigan at Villanova
The No. 18 Michigan Wolverines face the Villanova Wildcats in an NCAA Division I Men's game. Michigan rides a two-game win streak with Trey McKenney, while Villanova lost 81-61 to Pittsburgh on Nov. 17 with Devin Royal in non-conference play.

title: College Football
description:
Utah at TCU
The No. 2 Utah Utes (10-0, 7-0 Big 12) visit the TCU Horned Frogs (5-5, 3-4) in Fort Worth. Undefeated Utah enters after edging Arizona 40-39 on the road, while TCU seeks back-to-back wins at home following a 20-10 victory over Kansas State.
